book.name: Naꞌ Markus
book.title: Aꞌan Alekot matoom neu Usif Jesus, natuin Naꞌ Markus in sulat

content: Mansian nmoeꞌ sin ukan ma kaisa nseek Uisneno In aplenat
Nmuiꞌ atoni anoinaꞌ Farisi puukn es, nok kulu akama sin fafauk neem naꞌko Jerusalem he naꞌeuk nok Jesus.

Atoni Farisi sin nnaaꞌ maꞌtaniꞌ sin nonot Jahudi. Letaꞌ on leꞌ: atoni kalu he naah, musti nafano ꞌniman natuin nonot in lalan. On nane msat, kalu nfain naꞌko pasaꞌ, sin musti naniun feꞌ. Namnees on leꞌ, baleꞌ mbi uim hanaꞌ in nanan, on leꞌ naꞌi hanaꞌ, pika, kopu, buli, ok-okeꞌ musti mafase natuin nonot in lalan, niꞌ nabeiꞌ sin naah nekin. Kalu nmuiꞌ atoni Jahudi bian leꞌ ka natuin fa sin nonot, atoni Farisi sin namaun. Es on nane te, sin namaunun, fun olas nane sin napeen niit Jesus In asium-noinaꞌ sin mbukaen, ka nfaes fa ꞌniimk in natuin nonot in lalan. Nalali te, sin neman nasanat Jesus mnak, “Anasaaꞌ te Ho asium-noinaꞌ sin nbukaen, ka nfaes fa ꞌniimk in? Nane sin tanhaiꞌ hit nonot naꞌko naꞌi sin!”
Mes Jesus natae mnak, “Hi leꞌ ii, namneo atoni leꞌ naꞌuab naik, mes nmoeꞌ ta naik! Naꞌko un-unuꞌ naꞌi Jesaya nluul nalail Uisneno in laes fuaf am nak,

content.text: meki haa hi lulum tuunm in,
mes ka nok fa hi nekam naanm in.
Hi mmoeꞌ on leꞌ nane, mes palsuma.
Hi ka mtoe maan Kau fa Au ꞌlomik,
mes hi mituina haa mansian in aꞌlomin.’

content: Hi namnees on leꞌ atoni nane kin msat.
Hi maikoit milail Uisneno in aꞌloemn aa be, he mituina haa mansian in nonot. Hi leꞌ nane mihine nneis es hi mmoeꞌ on nane!
Un-unuꞌ naꞌi Moijes natoon nalali Uisneno in aplenat be nak, ‘Hit musti taꞌbees teu hit enaꞌ-amaꞌ sin.’ Ma es antein mnak, ‘Kalu atoni es naꞌakan in enaꞌ-amaꞌ, in musti mahukuꞌ ma maꞌmateꞌ.’

Uisneno naꞌnoinaꞌ on nane, mes hi miꞌnoinaꞌ naik anfaan. Hi mak, ‘Kalu atoni he nfee bael tuluꞌ meseꞌ neu Uisneno, mes kalu olas nane in enaf-amaf nasuusp ok, mes leꞌ bael tuluꞌ nane ka nabeiꞌ fa he nfee leꞌ neu sin, fun tuluꞌ leꞌ nane he maꞌnaꞌat neu Uisneno.’
Nane fun, Au ꞌutoon ꞌulail ꞌak, hi maikoit milail Uisneno In aꞌlomin, he hi mseek meik plenat feꞌu. Nmuiꞌ plenat namfau es hi mseke mani be.”
Lasi amleꞌut leꞌ ampoi naꞌko atoni in nekan
Oke te, Jesus noꞌen atoni bian mbinuk nane nak, “Mitniin lek-leok, henati hi mihiin.
Saaꞌ leꞌ es antaam neu taik, nane ka mahaiꞌnisit fa neu atoni. Mes saaꞌ leꞌ es ampoi naꞌko taik, nane es haiꞌniis atoni.
[Sikau es malukeꞌ, mneen lek-leok!”]
Nalali te, Jesus nok In asium-noinaꞌ sin nnaon nasaitan atoni nane kin, he ntaam neu uum jes. Ma In asium-noinaꞌ sin ntoit laes letaꞌ nane in aꞌnaon.

Jesus natae mnak, “Hi ka mihiin fa msat? In aꞌnaonaꞌ on ii: saaꞌn ee es atoni naahn ee, nane naleok. Mes saaꞌ es leꞌ ampoi nfain, nane es ka nalekof. Saaꞌn aa leꞌ es hit taahn ee, ntaam neu hit teik. Nalali te, mpoin nfain. (Usif Jesus nak, atoni nabeiꞌ naah saaꞌ-saaꞌ. Leꞌ nane ka maꞌekaꞌ fa.)
Saaꞌ leꞌ es ampoi naꞌko atoni in nekan, nane es neik naꞌkotoꞌ niꞌ atoni, tala Uisneno maiꞌniis ne, ma ka nloem fa nabua nok ne.
Lasi amleꞌut namfau leꞌ mpoi naꞌko atoni in nekan! Namnees on leꞌ: naneꞌop amleꞌut, lasi lahi, lais bakan, lasi naꞌmaet atoni,
lais paluꞌ, naleꞌun atoni, putal atoni, sinmakat, maneek-nanan, naꞌuab naꞌleꞌuf atoni, anteol, ka maꞌnoinaꞌ, ma naꞌnaak faut.
Aleꞌ ok-okeꞌ leꞌ amleꞌut nane, mpoi naꞌko atoni in nekan. Nane esan neik naleuꞌ ne. Uisneno maiꞌniis ne msat.”
Usif Jesus namnau bifeel meseꞌ leꞌ ka atoni Jahudi fa

Nalali te, Jesus sin nasaitan bale nane, he nnaon neu koot es, kanan Tirus. Nnaon ntenuk nane, sin ntaam neu uum jes, fun Jesus ka nloem fa atoni nahiin nak In es nane. Mes In ka nabeiꞌ fa he In naꞌkoloꞌ In aon.
Mbi nane, nmuiꞌ bifeel meseꞌ ka atoni Jahudi fa. In nahoins ee mbi kuan Fenesia, mbi profinsia Siria nae. Olas in nneen nak Jesus neem, in nnao ntoit Jesus he nliuꞌ napoin pah-tuaf naꞌko in aan feto.

Mes Jesus naꞌuab laes polin mnak, “Liꞌanaꞌ sin musti naah nahunun feꞌ, he niꞌ npolin maak nesif nane neu asu.” [Ma nok laes polin, Jesus musti namnau In atoni Jahudi sin feꞌ, he niꞌ namnau atoni bian.]

Mes bifeel nane natae mnak, “Namneo, Amaꞌ! Mes asu nane, in es meij aa nupun. In naah maklapuf msat leꞌ anmouf naꞌko liꞌanaꞌ in pikaꞌ lulun.” [In aꞌnaonaꞌ nak, olas liꞌanaꞌ sin nanahan, asu nabeiꞌ naah amsat. Masti Jesus namnau In atoin in, mes In musti namnau atoni bian msat.]
Nneen on nane te, Jesus natoon mnak, “Haaa! Enaꞌ, ho muꞌuab amtoom! Es on nane, enaꞌ ho mnao mfain nai, fun pah-tuaf nane mpoi nalail naꞌko ho aan feto be.”
Nalali te, bifeel nane nnao nfain. Ntee in ume, in aan feto nane ntuup anfiin. Ma pah-tuaf nane mpoi jen.
Usif Jesus nalekoꞌ atoni es nmoon ma ntonoꞌ

Nalali te, Jesus sin nnaon nasaitan koot Tirus, nnaon mbi koot Sidon natuin tasi ninen. Naꞌko nane, sin nnaon piut neu nifu ꞌnaek Galilea. Oke te, sin nnaon mbi baal es nok koot boꞌes, leꞌ sin anteek ee nak, ‘Dekapolis’.
Mbi nane, nmuiꞌ atoni es nmoon ma ntonoꞌ. In aok-biak in nok ne nnao neu Jesus. Sin ntoit he Jesus ntao In aꞌniman neu in aꞌnakan, ma he naleok ee.
Ma Jesus nasaitan toob amfaut in nane he nnao nmees nok atoni nane. Jesus ntao In ꞌniman fuan neu atoni nane in luken nua sin. Oke te, In npulan hape neu In ꞌniman fuan, ma nlaab atoni nane in maan.
Jesus nfuat on neno tunan, ma nheel asnasan amenat, oke te nlelu mnak, “Efata”, (in aꞌnaonaꞌ nak, “Mutfei nai!”)
In naꞌuab on nane haa, ma atoni nane in luken natsoi nain. Atoni in maan leꞌ maꞌtaniꞌ nane, maluel nain, tal antee in naꞌuab alekot-alekot.

Nalali te, sin nua sin nnaon nfain neu atoin amfaut in. Jesus naꞌekaꞌ sin nak, “Mneen, he! Hi kaisa mitoon atoni bian mak, Au ꞌesa ꞌuleko atoni ije.” Masti Jesus npaaꞌ sin maꞌtaniꞌ, sin ka naꞌebok fa, mes natoon ambi mee-mee.
Atoni-atoni leꞌ nnenan molok nane, sin namkakan. Sin mantonin mnak, “Atoni ije, lo-esan! Atoni ije, nmoeꞌ saaꞌ-saaꞌ nabeiꞌ naleok okeꞌ. Atonoꞌ nabeiꞌ nneen. Ma amonot nabeiꞌ namolok.”

footnotes.text: Lulat lasi Gregu (Yunani) leꞌ unuꞌ, ka matuiꞌ fa elaꞌ 16 ii.
